def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors=set(x for row in grid for x in row)-{grid[0][0]}
    for color in colors:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if len(pts)<2:
            continue
        # Two aligned adjacent points establish the ray direction.
        found=False
        for r,c in pts:
            for dr in (-1,1):
                for dc in (-1,1):
                    if (r+dr,c+dc) in pts:
                        # Extend beyond the endpoint in the same direction.
                        pr,pc=r,c
                        while (pr+dr,pc+dc) in pts:
                            pr+=dr; pc+=dc
                        while 0<=pr+dr<h and 0<=pc+dc<w and grid[pr+dr][pc+dc]==grid[0][0]:
                            pr+=dr; pc+=dc
                            out[pr][pc]=color
                        found=True
                        break
                if found: break
            if found: break
    return out
PY
